description: Chinese IME for Windows (Zhuyin/Bopomofo, Pinyin, Shuangpin) built on libchewing
notes: Installs system-wide through the MSI and asks for administrator rights (UAC).
InputMethodEditor updates itself in place, which bypasses Scoop.
Turn off automatic update checks in Settings > About and upgrade with: scoop update inputmethodeditor
User dictionary and settings are kept on uninstall: %AppData%\InputMethodEditor and HKCU\Software\InputMethodEditor

script: # The .msi_ rename stops Scoop from unpacking the MSI; the IME must be registered by a real install.
if ($p.ExitCode -notin 0, 3010) { throw "msiexec /i failed with exit code $($p.ExitCode)" }
# Look up the installed ProductCode: the in-app updater may have replaced the version Scoop installed.
if ($p.ExitCode -notin 0, 3010) { throw "msiexec /x failed with exit code $($p.ExitCode)" }
